prompt: Create an app icon sprite sheet with exactly 50 icons in the attached 54-square lattice. Preserve exactly six columns and nine rows on the 1536 by 2304 canvas: each square is exactly 256 by 256 pixels. Fill the first 50 cells with the listed icons, left to right then top to bottom. Only cells 51 through 54 are unused: leave these four bottom-right squares entirely plain white, without symbols. The last row starts with Eye and Eye Off; do not leave the entire last row blank. Preserve every square's position and boundaries exactly. Each occupied square has its specified solid-color background reaching all four edges and all four sharp 90-degree corners. NO rounded tile corners, gutters, padding, outer margins, footer, extra bands, captions, or exterior shadows. Replace checkerboards and guide lines with the specified backgrounds. Use crisp white symbols with subtle internal depth. If resolution differs, scale the entire lattice uniformly.
